overviewParagraphs: Chiang Mai Highlands Golf & Country Club is one of the most visually spectacular courses in northern Thailand — a Lee Schmidt design that threads through rolling highland terrain east of Chiang Mai city, delivering mountain panoramas from virtually every tee box and approach shot on the course. The cool highland air, the dramatic elevation changes, and the quality of Schmidt's routing combine to create an experience that feels refreshingly different from lowland resort golf.

Schmidt's design intelligence is evident in the way the course uses the natural terrain to create risk-reward moments without resorting to artificial obstacles — the hills themselves provide the strategic variety, with uphill approaches demanding extra club selection and downhill tee shots requiring precision placement for manageable approaches. The greens are consistently firm and fast, requiring subtle reads and controlled approaches.

AGS pairs Chiang Mai Highlands regularly with Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai to create a compelling two-round Chiang Mai program — the valley character of Alpine contrasted with the highland panoramas of Highlands makes for a genuinely complete northern Thailand golf experience. Both courses are consistently rated among the best golf experiences available in Asia by top international golf media.

curatorBriefHtml: Chiang Mai Highlands Golf and Spa Resort (opened 2005 by Schmidt-Curley Design in the Mae On foothills, 45 minutes east of Chiang Mai) is widely regarded as Northern Thailand’s most scenic and best-conditioned 27-hole championship course. Playing 6,872 yards (Par 72), every hole is framed by rolling misty mountain peaks, over 100 crisp sculpted bunkers, and slick Paspalum greens that consistently rank among the finest putting surfaces in Thailand.

Having played Chiang Mai Highlands personally, the immaculate turf quality and serene mountain silence hit you from the first tee — completely removed from urban noise, with crisp highland air and rewarding elevation swings across all three 9-hole loops.
Chiang Mai Highlands is the headline round on our Lanna Heritage Golf Trail, pairing effortlessly with Alpine Chiang Mai and Mae Jo.

scorecard.itemName: Chiang Mai Highlands Golf and Spa Resort
scorecard.verdict: Consistently voted among the top golf experiences in Asia. Schmidt-Curley carved 27 majestic holes into the northern foothills, offering breathtaking views, cavernous bunkers, and cool highland breezes.

faqs.q: How far is Chiang Mai Highlands from central Chiang Mai?
faqs.a: Approximately 45 minutes east of central Chiang Mai and Chiang Mai International Airport (CNX) by private touring vehicle along a scenic foothill drive.

faqs.q: What makes Chiang Mai Highlands Northern Thailand's #1 rated course?
faqs.a: Schmidt-Curley’s sweeping foothill routing, more than 100 gleaming sculpted bunkers, panoramic mountain backdrops on every hole, and consistently fast, pristine greens.

faqs.q: How many holes does Chiang Mai Highlands have?
faqs.a: 27 championship holes (three 9-hole loops) plus an on-site boutique resort villa complex and full spa for optional stay-and-play nights.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Chiang Mai Highlands?
faqs.a: November through February brings cool, crystal-clear Northern Thailand mornings (15–26°C) and peak mountain visibility.
